scripts.name: Verify
scripts.command: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; c=$(docker run -d --rm -e POSTGRES_DB=canvas_test -e POSTGRES_USER=canvas_test -e POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD=trust -p 127.0.0.1::5432 postgres:18.4-bookworm); trap "docker rm -f $c >/dev/null" EXIT; n=0; until docker exec "$c" pg_isready -q -h 127.0.0.1 -U canvas_test; do n=$((n+1)); [ $n -lt 60 ] || { echo "PostgreSQL did not become ready" >&2; exit 1; }; sleep 1; done; CANVAS_TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://canvas_test@$(docker port "$c" 5432/tcp | head -1)/canvas_test bash scripts/verify.sh'
